# vergeio_tenants (Data Source)

Lists tenants on the parent system. `filter_name` keeps an exact name match. Each entry includes `powerstate` and, when VergeOS has assigned one, `ui_address`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vergeio_tenants" "all" {
}

data "vergeio_tenants" "customer" {
  filter_name = "customer-a"
}

output "tenant_ui_address" {
  value = data.vergeio_tenants.customer.tenants[0].ui_address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String) Exact tenant name. Omit to list every tenant.

### Read-Only

- `tenants` (Attributes List) Tenants visible to this provider configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenants))

<a id="nestedatt--tenants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tenants`

Read-Only:

- `allow_branding` (Boolean) Whether the tenant may customize branding.
- `created` (Number) Creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `creator` (String) Username that created the tenant.
- `description` (String) Tenant description.
- `expose_cloud_snapshots` (Boolean) Whether the tenant may request system cloud snapshots.
- `id` (Number) Tenant key.
- `is_snapshot` (Boolean) Whether this record is a snapshot.
- `isolate` (Boolean) Whether network isolation is enabled.
- `name` (String) Tenant name.
- `powerstate` (Boolean) Whether the tenant is powered on.
- `state` (String) Simplified tenant state.
- `status` (String) Tenant status string.
- `theme_access` (String) Theme visibility.
- `ui_address` (String) IP address of the tenant UI.
- `ui_address_id` (Number) Key of the vnet address row for the tenant UI.
- `url` (String) URL recorded on the tenant.
- `uuid` (String) Tenant UUID.
- `vnet` (Number) Key of the network created for the tenant.
